name: Screen a list of names against EU financial sanctions (Google Sheets)

parameters.content:
## Screen a list of names against the EU consolidated sanctions list
Reads a `name` column from a Google Sheet, screens every name in **one** run of the **itulo/eu-sanctions-screen** Apify actor (European Commission Financial Sanctions Files, consolidated list), and writes one result row per candidate to a second tab.

**Setup**
1. Install the Apify node (`@apify/n8n-nodes-apify`) and add an Apify API credential.
2. Tab 1: a column `name`. Tab 2: empty results tab (headers are created from the first run).
3. Tune `fuzzyThreshold` in **Build screening input**.

**Important:** results are an informational aid, not legal advice. `possible_match` rows need manual review against the Official Journal of the EU; only the regulations published there are legally binding.

Data: European Commission, consolidated list of persons, groups and entities subject to EU financial sanctions; reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. Keep the attribution column.

nodes.name: Screen against EU sanctions list
nodes.notes: Apify Store actor https://apify.com/itulo/eu-sanctions-screen (pay-per-event). Add your own Apify API credential.

parameters.jsCode:
// One row per (query, candidate). Fuzzy scores are review indicators, never determinations.
return $input.all().map(i => i.json).map(r => ({ json: {
  query: r.query,
  status: r.status,                 // exact_match | possible_match | clear ...
  score: r.score ?? '',
  matchedName: r.primaryName || '',
  subjectType: r.subjectType || '',
  programme: r.programme || '',
  euReferenceNumber: r.euReferenceNumber || '',
  regulation: r.regulationNumberTitle || '',
  regulationUrl: r.regulationPublicationUrl || '',
  listPublicationDate: r.listPublicationDate || '',
  needsReview: r.status && r.status !== 'clear' ? 'YES' : 'no',
  disclaimer: r.disclaimer || '',
  attribution: r.attribution || '',
}}));
